tagline.en: Skywork's MIT-licensed interactive world model — steer a streaming game-style video with actions.
tagline.zh: Skywork 开源的 MIT 许可交互式世界模型——用动作实时操控游戏风格视频。

en: Matrix-Game 2.0 is an interactive world model from Skywork AI, released with open code and weights under the MIT license. Instead of rendering a fixed clip, it generates a streaming, game-style video that responds to action inputs, letting you drive the scene as it unfolds.

It works from an image plus a stream of control actions and produces action-controlled game video. WorldFoundry follows the official universal-mode defaults and uses an in-tree action-condition generator, so you don't need an external checkout to run it.
In WorldFoundry you launch the universal image route, provide a starting image and actions, and it synthesizes the interactive video for you.
zh: Matrix-Game 2.0 是 Skywork AI 推出的交互式世界模型，以 MIT 许可开放代码与权重。它不生成固定片段，而是生成随动作输入实时响应的、流式的游戏风格视频，让你能在场景展开的同时进行操控。
它以一张图片加上一串控制动作作为输入，输出受动作控制的游戏视频。WorldFoundry 沿用官方 universal 模式默认配置，并使用内置的动作条件生成器，无需外部代码库即可运行。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你启动 universal image 路径，给它一张起始图片与动作序列，它就会为你合成这段可交互视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want an openly-licensed interactive world model — generating game-like video that you can steer with actions from a starting image, rather than a one-shot render.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放许可的交互式世界模型时使用——从起始图片出发、用动作操控生成游戏式视频，而非一次性渲染。

notFor.en: Not for classic offline text-to-video prompting or long non-interactive films; its focus is short, action-driven interactive rollouts. Checkpoints are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 不适合传统离线的文生视频提示或长篇非交互影片；它专注于短时、动作驱动的交互式生成。Checkpoint 需单独下载。
